material.title: Example City Council to enforce grease trap rule at all eateries from 1 March
material.bodyOriginal: Example City Council said every food premises in the city must install a grease trap and clean it weekly from 1 March. Operators without one face a fine of up to RM2,000, and inspections start the same month.
